question_en: An AC drive is repaired and operating conditions changed. What may need adjustment before final testing?
options: Programming.
Base the decision only on equipment age.
Use only the enclosure colour as the reference.
Rely only on purchase records instead of technical information.
explanation_en: D-23.02 states programming is adjusted according to the repair and changes in operating conditions.
explanation_es: D-23.02 indica que la programación se ajusta según la reparación y cambios de condiciones de operación.

question_en: Which action best supports condition-based AC-drive maintenance?
options: Compare and analyze drive parameters.
Base the decision only on equipment age.
Use only the enclosure colour as the reference.
Rely only on purchase records instead of technical information.
explanation_en: D-23.02 explicitly calls for comparison and analysis of drive parameters.
explanation_es: D-23.02 exige comparar y analizar los parámetros del drive.

question_en: After AC-drive repair, what must the assembly do?
options: Function according to manufacturer specifications and facility requirements.
Base the decision only on equipment age.
Use only the enclosure colour as the reference.
Rely only on purchase records instead of technical information.
explanation_en: The RSOS requires post-repair testing and correct function to manufacturer/facility requirements.
explanation_es: El RSOS exige prueba posterior y funcionamiento conforme a especificaciones del fabricante y requisitos de la instalación.

question_en: An AC drive power component has been replaced. What should be completed before returning the drive to normal service?
options: Adjust programming if required by the repair or operating conditions, then test against manufacturer and facility requirements.
Base the decision only on equipment age.
Use only the enclosure colour as the reference.
Rely only on purchase records instead of technical information.
explanation_en: D-23.02 requires programming adjustment where needed and post-repair testing to manufacturer/facility requirements.
explanation_es: D-23.02 exige ajustar programación cuando sea necesario y realizar pruebas posteriores según fabricante/instalación.

question_en: Which parameter is listed for AC-drive maintenance analysis?
options: Acceleration/deceleration rate.
Building occupancy count.
Conduit paint colour.
Emergency lighting duration.
explanation_en: Acceleration/deceleration rate is one of the drive parameters listed by the RSOS.
explanation_es: La tasa de aceleración/deceleración es uno de los parámetros listados por el RSOS.
